index.headline: One platform, three clearly separated workspaces.
index.lede: NEXACART is a role aware e-commerce platform. Secure accounts, a reliable sign-in and access control that keeps every person inside the workspace that belongs to them.
index.hero_note: Administrator accounts are created by the platform owner, so that only a trusted person can manage users, roles and the activity log.
index.access_intro: Permissions are enforced on the server for every request - hiding a button is a convenience, the real check happens before the page is rendered.
index.access_caption: Access rights per role and area
index.access_row_four: Own account settings and active devices
index.features_title: Built around the person, not the page
index.feature_one_text: Passwords are salted and hashed, sessions live on the server, and every sign-in attempt is logged. Accounts lock temporarily after repeated failures.
index.feature_two_text: Every form explains what is wrong in plain language and points at the field that needs attention, so nobody is left guessing.
index.feature_three_text: Each person is redirected to the workspace that matches their role, and sees only the tools that belong to it.
index.feature_four_text: A live strength checklist, a password generator and the option to end other sessions from the security page.
index.cta_text: Create an account and NEXACART takes you straight to the workspace that matches your role.

about.title: How NEXACART works
about.intro: Pick your role below to read a short guide for it.
about.admin_lead: You manage the platform: accounts, approvals and the activity log.
about.seller_lead: You list products and manage stock.
about.buyer_lead: You browse the catalogue and shop.
about.admin_steps.0: New accounts are created unapproved and appear in the Approvals queue.
about.admin_steps.1: Approving or rejecting an account requires your password.
about.admin_steps.2: Changing a role notifies the person; the message appears in their app the next time they open it.
about.admin_steps.3: Promoting someone to administrator also requires your password.
about.admin_steps.4: Every action is recorded in the Activity log.
about.seller_steps.0: Register with an account; an administrator approves it before you can sign in.
about.seller_steps.1: Add products with name, description, price, stock and a photo.
about.seller_steps.2: Your products appear on the dashboard and in the product area.
about.seller_steps.3: Stock decreases automatically when a buyer pays.
about.seller_steps.4: Low stock items are flagged on your dashboard.
about.buyer_steps.0: Register with an account; an administrator approves it before you can sign in.
about.buyer_steps.1: Add products to your cart; quantities are limited by available stock.
about.buyer_steps.2: Checkout creates an order and takes payment.
about.buyer_steps.3: Paid orders are listed on your dashboard.
about.buyer_steps.4: You can change your currency and edit your business profile at any time.
about.general_lead: NEXACART is a marketplace with three roles. Here is how everything works.

general_steps.0: Every person has an account with a role: administrator, seller or buyer.
general_steps.1: Every publicly created account waits for administrator approval before the first sign-in.
general_steps.2: Sellers add products with a photo, price and stock.
general_steps.3: Buyers browse the catalogue, fill a cart and pay.
general_steps.4: Accounts can change their currency and complete a business profile.
general_steps.5: Every important action is recorded in the activity log.
